title: Flambe Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish made with flambe and egg, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the flambe and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the pilaf and stir to combine with the flambe.
Beat in the egg and stir until the egg is cooked through.
Add the saujak if using and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
